Preparations for the French Nationals (28-29 sept in Rennes)

Where: Troll2jeux, 22 rue Hector Malot, Paris
When: 15-09-2012, R1 starts at 11 AM. Registrations start at 10:20 AM.
Fee: 5e for adherents of the VEKN: Paris, 7 euros for others. (adherence fee: 2 euros)
Format: standard constructed, 3R+F. Decklists and sleeves are required.
